latestVersion.changelog:
AI Video Converter — Version 1.0.0

- Initial public release of the AI-driven video converter skill.
- Instantly convert MOV, AVI, MKV, and WebM files (up to 500MB) to MP4 at 1080p via a cloud rendering pipeline.
- Simple, conversational interface—just upload your video or describe the desired output.
- Automatic session setup and free token generation with 100 credits valid for 7 days.
- Supports querying credits, checking job status, exporting results, and reviewing timeline state.
- Fast conversion for short clips (typically under 40 seconds for videos under 3 minutes).
